messages:
Marcos: heads-up — small-GPU pods tail latency spiked in us-east1c after the tenant rollout at 01:05. many 1GPU replicas Pending -> Preempted.
Priya: timeline? scheduler traces?
Marcos: warmpool dropped from 180 -> 34 in ~16m. events show `FailedAttach` then `Preempted`. weirdly the packer concentrated long-seq jobs into a couple of 'shelf' nodes (nvlink=true) and left pockets of tiny pods elsewhere.
Eileen: we enabled per-tenant rack affinity to improve cache locality overnight. looks like one tenant's long-seq batch pinned several racks and created "pockets" where small pods couldn't get warm attach.
infra-bot: ALERT: us-east1c warm-pool depletion at 8777770102. affected pods: 95 small-gpu inference, preemptions: 172.
NetOps: also seeing conntrack spikes on racks r4-r6 which amplified attach latencies there. those racks are where many small pods were landing after initial placement.
Priya: sounds like three-way interaction: tenant affinity + packer long-seq bias + rack conntrack -> pocketing and thrash. quick mitigations: 1) deploy an admission mutator to tag tiny pods `placement.hint=latency` (fast), 2) bump warmpool.min in the AZ, 3) soften tenant affinity.
Marcos: I can deploy the mutator now. rule: if `resources.limits.nvidia.com/gpu == 1 && annotations.seq_len < "600"` -> set `labels['placement.hint']='latency'`.
Eileen: I'll start a soft roll of tenant-affinity toggle to relax hard rack pins. also lowering packer nvlink-preference to be a topology hint only.
infra-bot: ACTION: mutator applied at 8777770150. warmpool.patch submitted at 8777770162.
Priya: infra, executing warmpool bump: `kubectl -n infra patch warmpool us-east1c -p '{"spec":{"minSize":210}}'` — applied. watch preempt rates.
NetOps: beginning rack rehab for r4; conntrack backlog draining. ETA ~22m.
Marcos: early metrics: pending queue dropping, tiny pods admitted on warm nodes again. but we have a cohort of pods that were bounced multiple times — they keep missing attach window and immediately reschedule -> preempt loops.
Eileen: can we add an `attach_retry_backoff` for `placement.hint=latency` pods so they wait before rescheduling? lowers bounce. I'll open a quick scheduler patch.
Priya: also add a short-lived "cold-attach penalty" in scheduler scoring: penalize nodes where attach failures recently occurred so we avoid immediate reschedule onto same rack.
SRE Oncall: agreed. immediate follow-ups: 1) implement attach_retry_backoff for latency-tagged pods 2) add per-rack `seq_len_concentration` metric and alert when >60% long-seq 3) make tenant-affinity togglable with spill threshold 4) fix conntrack auto-rotation for racks with high attach latencies.
Marcos: filing incident ticket with traces and a sample `kubectl describe` dump. adding runbook note: if warm-pool < 30% baseline, bump to baseline+25% and deploy latency mutator.
infra-bot: RESOLVED: warm-pool recovered at 8777770280. preempt rate returned to baseline at 8777770295.
Eileen: follow-up PRs: packer cap to avoid >50% long-seq on same rack, scheduler cold-attach penalty, and mutator e2e tests. I'll link after posting.
Priya: thanks team. we'll review tenant-affinity defaults in next ops sync and add a canary for any affinity-affecting packer change. :thumbsup:
